title: Unguarded 2-letter suffix strip makes 'Santa Fe' queries return Santa Cruz matches
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/TeamNameNormalizer.cs:78-79 BareTrailingStateRegex '\s+[A-Za-z]{2}$' strips any trailing 2-letter token without checking StateCodes. Verified by compiling the shipped normalizer in a temp copy: NormalizeTeam('Ind. Santa Fe')='ind. santa', NormalizeTeam('Santa Fe' as query)='santa', so TeamMatches('Santa Cruz','Santa Fe')=True. 'Ind. Santa Fe' appears in 52 rows of data/kaggle/Libertadores_Matches.csv.
suggestion: Only strip the trailing token when it is a member of the already-declared StateCodes set.

title: 'Athletic Club MG' normalizes to the empty string and is unreachable by any query
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/TeamNameNormalizer.cs:78-88 — bare strip removes 'MG', then ClubFormTokens strips 'athletic club', leaving ''. Verified: NormalizeTeam('Athletic Club MG')='' and TeamMatches('Athletic Club MG','Athletic Club MG')=False (guard at line 123 returns false on empty key). Label occurs in 1 row of data/kaggle/BR-Football-Dataset.csv; GetStandings (SoccerQueryService.cs:150) would also key such teams under ''.
suggestion: Fall back to the diacritics-normalized raw label when token stripping empties the key.

title: StateCodes HashSet is declared but never referenced (dead code, and the root cause of norm-1/norm-2)
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/TeamNameNormalizer.cs:43-49 declares StateCodes; `grep -rn StateCodes src/ --include=*.cs` returns only that declaration — no read site. The suffix regexes at lines 134-138 match any letters instead.
suggestion: Wire StateCodes into both suffix-stripping rules, or delete it.

title: search_matches/search_players report the post-truncation count as the number found
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Tools/SoccerTools.cs:55-62 — the list is .Take(limit)'d before Count is read, so the header prints 'Found 25 match(es)' when the filter matched hundreds; same pattern at SoccerTools.cs:206-215 for players.
suggestion: Materialize the total before Take() and report 'Found N, showing M'.

title: head_to_head total counts unscored matches while W/D/L exclude them, so the printed lines do not sum
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/SoccerQueryService.cs:101 sets Total=matches.Count (all matches) while lines 84-95 skip !m.HasScore when tallying; SoccerTools.cs:81-84 prints Total beside WinsA/WinsB/Draws.
suggestion: Report Total as the scored-match count, or print 'N of M matches with a recorded score'.

title: Relegation flag is applied to any competition with >=20 teams, including knockout cups
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Data/SoccerQueryService.cs:171 — `Relegated = i >= rows.Count - 4 && rows.Count >= 20` has no competition guard, so competition_standings for copa_do_brasil or libertadores (both reachable via SoccerTools.cs:126) flags bottom-four teams as relegated.
suggestion: Restrict the relegation flag to the league competitions (Brasileirao, HistoricoBrasileirao).

title: Same-name clubs from different states collide into one canonical key (documented, but affects standings and H2H)
evidence: TeamNameNormalizer.cs:23-27 and README.md:59-60 accept this; verified TeamMatches('Botafogo - PB','Botafogo - RJ')=True. Across data/kaggle/, 'botafogo' collapses 5+ distinct labels (Botafogo, Botafogo-PB, Botafogo-RJ, ...), likewise 'atletico' (Atletico-GO/MG/PR) and 'america' (America-MG/RN).
suggestion: Retain the parsed state as a tiebreaker in the canonical key, or add a curated alias map for the affected clubs.

title: Beyond spec: extended BR-Football stats, list_* discovery tools, and venue filtering
evidence: src/BrazilianSoccerMcp/Models/Match.cs:56-61 carries corners/attacks/shots; SoccerTools.cs:247-294 adds list_competitions/list_seasons/list_teams; SoccerTools.cs:101 adds a home/away venue filter not required by the checklist.
suggestion: None — noted as credit, not a deduction.
